about: Human semantic review of the figures the machine audit leaves REVIEW_REQUIRED (no deterministic assertion covers the chemistry — reference data, prose claims, a fixed React card, a generated or approved figure). Keyed by figure instance and BOUND to the figure's fingerprint: if a figure changes, its review is void and src/tests/chemistrySemanticReview.test.ts fails naming it. 'decision' is PASS (reviewed, no defect, evidence cited), FIXED→PASS (a real defect was found and fixed, evidence cited) or REVIEW_REQUIRED (still not decidable by this repository; reason and owner decision recorded). The machine verdicts in audit-summary.json are NOT edited by this file. Evidence is a file and the text it must still contain; sources are the public references the reviewers read. Independent reviews are recorded in tier3-independent-review.json, prose-figure-review.json, reference-data-ledger.json and periodic-reference-ledger.json; where I (the author of the fixes) read a figure myself — electrode roles in three cells without a printed potential, the fixed cards — the entry says so and rests on deterministic tests.

scene:comparison-log-Kf:-the-chelate-eff.initial: semantic audit REVIEW_REQUIRED (no deterministic assertion covers this family)
scene:comparison-log-Kf:-the-chelate-eff.finding: Two bars: [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ log Kf 13.0 and [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ 18.8. EDTA 18.8 MATCHES (20 °C, 0.1 M). 13.0 sits inside the range general-chemistry texts quote (1.1–2.1 × 10¹³) but the critical compilation gives log β₄ = 11.75 (25 °C, I = 0), ~1.25 log units lower, and the figure states no conditions. The pair is also not like-for-like for the "chelate effect": EDTA is hexadentate N₂O₄ and 4− charged, the effect is cleanest at equal donor sets (Cu: 4 NH₃ = 11.75 vs 2 en = 19.55, same table, 25 °C, I = 0). The Educational Brain's own example is [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ vs [Ni(NH₃)₆]²⁺.
scene:comparison-log-Kf:-the-chelate-eff.remaining: Typography fixed here ([Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ superscript, matching [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺); the data and the comparison are not changed.
sources: Martell & Smith, Critical Stability Constants, via Harvey (LibreTexts) Formation Constants
scene:comparison-log-Kf:-the-chelate-eff.reason: The value 13.0 is unverified against a critical compilation at stated conditions (UNVERIFIED in the reference-data ledger) and the EDTA-vs-NH₃ pair mixes denticity with donor set and charge. Neither is false, but a learner is not told the conditions or the caveat, and which fix is right is a teaching decision.
scene:comparison-log-Kf:-the-chelate-eff.ownerDecision: Owner / curriculum to choose: (a) keep and add the conditions and the caveat to the figure; (b) switch to the like-for-like pair, Cu²⁺ with 4 NH₃ (log β₄ 11.75) vs 2 en (log β₂ 19.55), both Martell & Smith, 25 °C, I = 0; (c) use the Educational Brain's Ni(en)₃ / Ni(NH₃)₆ pair.
